А если сканируемый объект движется? В эт: But what if the scanned object is moving? In this case, the parts (narrow illuminated strips) will be recorded at the moment when the reading carriage passes under them, so the image of the object will be distorted. However, these distorted images can be used to study the laws of motion of bodies moving near the working surface of the scanner.
Большие возможности для изучения периоди: The TV screen offers great opportunities for studying periodic processes, as it can act as a spatial stroboscope.

Дело в том, что каждая точка экрана теле: The fact is that each point on the TV screen lights up at a specific moment, namely when the electron beam of the cathode-ray tube hits it. The image is formed as a darkening, i.e., blocking of the electron beam radiation by the object (or its part). Therefore, we see the moving object on the screen not instantly and entirely: its different parts light up at different times, so the visible image can differ significantly from the real shape of the moving object!
